title: TCP, TLS and HTTPS
description: Understand transport, authenticated encryption and HTTPS certificate verification through a loopback TCP exercise and safe TLS identity checks.
objectives: Distinguish TCP transport from encrypted TLS and HTTP
Explain certificate trust, hostname checks and expiration
Use Node networking to exchange bytes with a local TCP server
Diagnose a certificate name mismatch without disabling verification
rubric: I explained what TCP, TLS and HTTP each provide.
I inspected a trusted site's certificate identity and validity.
I ran the loopback TCP and certificate hostname tests.
